page.layout: One printed page: a title page, all lines centred in one block; below them a rule and an imprint in smaller type. No margins, no notes. The digitiser's cover banner ("Digitized by Google" logo) is left out.
page.notes: The title page is printed in a plain sans-serif on a teal ground, which appears to be a digitiser's cover rather than the original printed title. The ellipses ("...") after IC., RERUM and Suyderhoef, are as they appear on the scan. The imprint is the lower block under the rule. The rule itself is not text.
